svg.desc: Twenty-four males were tested in each of nine timed knockdown cohorts. The stage-5 cohort had a median courtship index of 7%, compared with 60% at stage 4 and 67% at stage 6. The corresponding mating counts were 0, 3 and 5 of 24. Each cohort is visible as individual courtship points and a separate mating count. In nematodes, fusion normally occurs in L4. Expression of either LIN-29 isoform beginning in L1 advanced fusion to early L2.

g.text: Time spent courting a female in adulthood (fly)
One square per male. Filled squares denote mating.
Timing of epidermal seam cell fusion in the nematode
Triangle: early expression begins. Circle: fusion observed. L1–L4: larval stages.
